purpose: MEASURED SYMBOL-CONVENTION BRIDGE between the research corpus's IPA and PHOIBLE 2.0's IPA. Research finding C-01 warns in its own words that a mixed symbol set silently inflates PER; this file is the countermeasure, and every mapping in it was MEASURED against the real PHOIBLE table this session, never assumed.
why_this_file_exists: The A2 coverage score looks each Turkish phone up in PHOIBLE's feature table. Measured 2026-08-15: 4 of the 69 phones in the research inventory are ABSENT from PHOIBLE as written - all four affricates. Tie-bar normalisation (stripping U+0361 / U+035C) resolved 0 of the 4, so the difference is not a tie bar. Enumerating every PHOIBLE segment containing an esh or ezh after a stop showed PHOIBLE's actual convention: it writes the postalveolar affricate with an explicit RETRACTED diacritic on the stop - `d̠ʒ` = U+0064 U+0320 U+0292 - and carries 73 such segments. That is the bridge below.
measurement_commands: the 4 absences and the failed tie-bar test: an inline scan of music_studio/data/phoible_segment_features.json against data/turkish_phoneme_inventory.json, 2026-08-15
PHOIBLE's affricate spelling: enumeration of every segment matching ('ʃ' or 'ʒ') AND a preceding stop - 73 segments, all using U+0320

diacritics_referenced.U+0320: COMBINING MINUS SIGN BELOW - IPA 'retracted'. PHOIBLE places it on the stop portion of a postalveolar affricate.
diacritics_referenced.U+02D0: MODIFIER LETTER TRIANGULAR COLON - length. Carried through the mapping unchanged.

research_to_phoible.verified: asserted by scripts/test_phonology_layer.py against the real table; the voiceless counterpart of the measured d̠ʒ pattern

unmapped_policy: A phone with no PHOIBLE counterpart is REPORTED as unmeasurable (FEATURES_UNAVAILABLE / unmeasurable in the coverage score) and is NEVER silently mapped onto a near symbol. An invented mapping would corrupt every distance computed from it, which is the defect class this project has paid for repeatedly.
